title: The Ipsos Energy Transition Barometer
discussion_signal: The post links support for energy transition to affordability and security, highlights anxiety about foreign energy dependence, concern over energy costs, weaker confidence in grid readiness for AI data centres, and tension between low prices and emissions goals.
linked_research_question: When energy transition becomes an everyday affordability and security issue, what conditions sustain public legitimacy for grids, AI demand, and climate policy?
limits: The post summarizes survey findings and does not provide the full country-level dataset
Reported attitudes do not establish actual energy consumption or voting behaviour
The account is professional commentary and may select findings that support the transition narrative
